paragraphs: As Hong Kong’s medical industry undergoes a transformative phase, medical space compliance design emerges as the cornerstone of ensuring safety and operational excellence. With the Private Healthcare Facilities Ordinance gazetted in May, 2025, and its Clinic Practice Code taking effect in October, medical facilities must adhere to stringent medical safety standards, with a transition period extending to April 13, 2026.

Once Design Studio, a distinguished expert in medical space design, offers profound insights into Hong Kong’s healthcare market, crafting environments that seamlessly blend safety, functionality, and aesthetic elegance for Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) clinics, dental centers, medical aesthetics hubs, and elderly care facilities. This article unveils key compliance essentials and engineering intricacies to guide your success.

blocks.heading: Hong Kong Medical Space Compliance Overview: Regulatory Shifts and Market Dynamics

blocks.alt: Medical Space Interior Design interior 1

paragraphs: The aging population, anticipated to reach 27% aged 65 and above by 2030, coupled with surging cross-border medical demand from the Greater Bay Area, propels industry evolution. The Private Healthcare Facilities Ordinance (2025) mandates compliance with fire safety, accessibility, and infection control standards, including 1.5m-wide corridors, concealed fire doors, and cleanroom-grade air conditioning (Class 100,000–10,000).
Once Design Studio collaborates with engineering consultants to ensure regulatory adherence while enhancing patient safety and operational efficiency.

blocks.heading: Clinic Design | Five Pivotal Compliance and Engineering Strategies
paragraphs: The essence of medical space design lies in adhering to medical safety standards. Below are five strategic imperatives for 2025 compliance and engineering excellence:

blocks.heading: 1. Fire Safety and Emergency Evacuation: Precision Meets Aesthetics
paragraphs: Per the Private Healthcare Facilities Ordinance and Fire Services Ordinance, medical spaces require concealed fire doors, automatic sprinkler systems, and emergency lighting, with each treatment room featuring at least two exits. Incorporate A1-grade fire-resistant partitions ensuring 30-minute durability, maintain 1.5m evacuation corridors, and install smoke detectors.

blocks.heading: 2. Accessibility and Age-Appropriate Design: Inclusive Excellence

title: Retail Store Design Guide: Crafting Compelling Brand Spaces to Elevate Sales Performance
author: ONCE DESIGN
description: Retail Store Design Guide: Crafting Compelling Brand Spaces to Elevate Sales Performance

paragraphs: In today’s fiercely competitive market, a retail store transcends its role as a mere point of sale, serving as an extension of brand identity and a cornerstone of customer experience

blocks.alt: Retail Store Design Guide — image 1

paragraphs: How do meticulously crafted retail stores leverage design to captivate customers and foster brand loyalty? This article delves into the essence of retail, showcases exemplary brand designs, explores five distinct types of retail store designs (including jewelry stores), highlights key considerations for mall storefronts, outlines essential product display strategies, and explains how to align design with brand identity to ultimately boost sales. For those planning to launch or revamp a retail store, this guide offers sophisticated insights and actionable inspiration.

blocks.heading: What is the Retail Industry?

blocks.alt: Retail Store Design Guide — image 2

paragraphs: The retail industry encompasses the direct sale of goods or services to end consumers, representing the final link in the supply chain. In Hong Kong, retail is a significant economic driver, spanning sectors such as fashion, food, and electronics. A retail store is the physical embodiment of this industry, tasked not only with selling products but also with creating an immersive environment that communicates brand values. Market research indicates that well-designed retail stores—through strategic use of lighting, color schemes, and spatial layouts—can profoundly influence purchasing decisions. At its core, retail is customer-centric, requiring retail store designs to align with the preferences and behaviors of the target audience.

blocks.heading: Exemplary Retail Store Brand Designs

blocks.alt: Retail Store Design Guide — image 3

paragraphs: Iconic brands leverage distinctive retail store designs to reinforce their identity and create memorable experiences. For instance, Apple Stores are renowned for their minimalist aesthetic, featuring sleek white tones, open layouts, and interactive display zones that evoke a tech-art gallery ambiance rather than a conventional retail store.

blocks.alt: Retail Store Design Guide — image 4

paragraphs: Similarly, Starbucks employs warm wooden elements and cozy seating to craft a “third space” where customers linger beyond their coffee purchase. Eslite Bookstore’s retail store design integrates bookshelves, reading nooks, and curated cultural products, transforming the space into a haven for literary enthusiasts. These examples underscore that retail store design is not merely about aesthetics but about storytelling that enhances customer loyalty.

blocks.heading: Five Types of Retail Store Designs

blocks.alt: Retail Store Design Guide — image 5

paragraphs: Different retail store categories demand tailored designs to suit their products and clientele. Below, we explore five prevalent types, including jewelry store design, to illustrate how industry-specific nuances shape compelling spaces.

blocks.heading: Fashion Retail Design
paragraphs: Prioritizes private fitting rooms and strategic lighting to accentuate fabric textures. Open layouts facilitate browsing, while mirrors amplify spatial perception. Mannequin displays can evoke a high-fashion atmosphere.

blocks.heading: Food Retail Design
paragraphs: Emphasizes hygiene and freshness, employing bright LED lights and glass cases to make products visually enticing. Interactive elements like tasting zones or open kitchens enhance engagement, with wooden shelving often used to convey natural authenticity.

blocks.heading: Electronics Retail Design
paragraphs: Focuses on a futuristic aesthetic, incorporating interactive screens and hands-on product zones. Spacious layouts prevent crowding, and features like charging stations or VR experiences add an entertainment dimension.

blocks.heading: Jewelry Store Design
paragraphs: Exudes luxury and security, utilizing subdued warm tones and bespoke display cases with precise spotlighting to highlight gemstone brilliance. Elegant storefronts paired with discreet security systems and exclusive VIP lounges reinforce a premium brand image.

blocks.heading: Bookstore Retail Design
paragraphs: Cultivates a serene reading environment with organized shelving and comfortable seating. Integrating a café or event space transforms the retail store into a cultural hub, encouraging prolonged customer visits.

blocks.heading: Key Considerations for Mall Storefront Design

blocks.alt: Retail Store Design Guide — image 6

paragraphs: A retail store’s mall storefront is its first impression, determining whether passersby step inside. Critical considerations include:
Visual Appeal: Employ striking signage and LED lighting to stand out in a crowded mall. Maintain simplicity to emphasize the brand logo without overwhelming viewers.
Spatial Efficiency: Given limited storefront width, use transparent glass displays to showcase flagship products, drawing the eye inward.
Color and Material Cohesion: Align hues and materials with brand identity—metallic finishes suit modern fashion retail stores, for example—while adhering to mall aesthetic guidelines.
Accessibility: Ensure wide entrances to accommodate wheelchairs, promoting inclusivity.
Seasonal Adaptability: Periodically refresh storefront décor with festive themes to maintain vibrancy.

blocks.heading: Essential Product Display Strategies
paragraphs: Product display is the heart of retail store design, directly impacting conversion rates. Effective displays guide customer journeys, extend dwell time, and elevate purchase intent.
Tiered Displays: Utilize high, mid, and low levels for accessibility, placing bestsellers at eye level (approximately 150–170 cm).
Thematic Zoning: Organize products by category, such as color or style in fashion retail stores, to create visual flow.
Lighting and Props: Use targeted lighting to highlight key items and props like mannequins to add dimension.
Interactive Features: Incorporate touchable displays or QR codes for additional product information, sparking purchase interest.
Maintenance and Updates: Regularly refresh displays to avoid clutter, preserving a polished retail store image.

blocks.heading: Aligning Design with Brand Identity

blocks.alt: Retail Store Design Guide — image 7

paragraphs: A retail store’s design must seamlessly reflect its brand identity to strengthen customer recognition. Begin by analyzing core brand values: an eco-conscious brand might employ recycled materials and green tones, while a luxury brand could incorporate metallic and leather accents. Spatial layouts should echo the brand narrative—for instance, a sports retail store might feature dynamic pathways mimicking an active lifestyle. Fine details, such as curated music, ambient scents, and cohesive staff uniforms, create an immersive experience. Through these efforts, a retail store evolves from a sales venue into a brand ambassador.

blocks.heading: Elevating Sales Through Design
paragraphs: Strategic design is a powerful tool for boosting retail store sales, with studies suggesting a potential 20–30% revenue increase. Key approaches include:
Optimized Customer Flow: Design circular pathways to encourage exploration of more products, minimizing dead zones.
Emotional Engagement: Incorporate storytelling walls or interactive installations to forge connections, driving purchases.
Data-Driven Adjustments: Leverage heatmaps to analyze customer behavior and refine display placements.
Multisensory Experiences: Combine visual, auditory, and tactile elements—like branded playlists or tactile product zones—to stimulate senses and enhance conversions.
Digital Integration: Introduce touchscreens or augmented reality fitting rooms to appeal to tech-savvy demographics.

blocks.heading: Core Principles of Living Room Design

blocks.alt: 2025 Living Room Design Guide — image 2

paragraphs: The success of a living room transformation hinges on mastering key design principles, particularly in Hong Kong’s space-constrained residences. Balancing functionality with aesthetic appeal is paramount to avoid common pitfalls, such as overcrowding or inadequate lighting. Below are five essential considerations to guide your planning:

blocks.heading: Spatial Planning and Flow Optimization
paragraphs: The layout profoundly impacts daily comfort. In Hong Kong’s typical 300-500 square foot apartments, position sofas against walls and maintain a 2-3 meter distance from the television to ensure unobstructed movement. L-shaped or modular furniture offers flexibility in adapting to dynamic needs. A frequent oversight is neglecting door and window placements, which can disrupt flow; mitigate this by drafting a floor plan to simulate household movement patterns.

blocks.heading: Layered Lighting Design
paragraphs: Lighting transcends mere illumination, shaping ambiance and mood. In 2025, smart lighting systems allow app-controlled adjustments of color temperature. Combine primary ceiling lights with wall sconces, floor lamps, and LED strips to create a spectrum from warm yellow (2700K) to cool white (5000K). In smaller living rooms, avoid low-hanging chandeliers that compress ceiling height; opt for recessed fixtures to enhance perceived spaciousness.

blocks.heading: Color and Material Selection
paragraphs: Color influences spatial perception. Neutral tones—ivory, soft gray, or earthy hues—are favored in Hong Kong for their ability to visually expand rooms. Material choices, such as warm wooden flooring or easy-to-clean stone tiles, add texture and durability. Sustainability is a 2025 trend, with recycled timber and low-VOC paints reducing environmental impact. Incorporate tactile elements like linen curtains for refined elegance.

blocks.heading: Storage and Organization Solutions
paragraphs: Clutter is a common issue in Hong Kong living rooms. Integrate concealed cabinetry to maintain a streamlined appearance. Wall-mounted shelves or multifunctional TV units maximize vertical space. Smart storage, such as drawer dividers for remotes or books, minimizes visual chaos.

blocks.heading: Personalization and Functional Integration
paragraphs: Infuse character with curated elements like greenery, artwork, or family heirlooms.  Consider household needs, such as rounded-edge furniture for families with young children, to ensure safety and practicality.

By adhering to these principles, you can optimize your renovation budget. Data suggests that strategic planning can reduce costs by up to 20%. If you’re unsure where to begin, start with precise measurements or consult Once Design Studio for a tailored solution.

blocks.heading: Living Room Design Styles
paragraphs: Living Room Design Style is a top concern for those researching living room renovations. Hong Kong homeowners gravitate toward practical yet stylish aesthetics. Below, we explore several trending styles, each accompanied by actionable advice to inspire your project.

blocks.heading: Nordic-Inspired Living Room Design: Serene Simplicity

blocks.alt: 2025 Living Room Design Guide — image 3

paragraphs: The Nordic-inspired Living Room Design rooted in Scandinavian principles, emphasizes natural light, wooden elements, and minimalist lines. Ideal for Hong Kong’s compact spaces, this style creates a tranquil retreat that visually enlarges rooms, remaining a top trend in 2025. This style’s timeless appeal and low maintenance make it perfect for Hong Kong’s fast-paced lifestyle. If you’re drawn to nature-inspired serenity, the Nordic aesthetic is an excellent choice.

Color and Materials: Anchor the palette in white or gray, accented with soft blues or greens. Opt for oak or pine furniture paired with wool rugs for warmth. Restraint in color variety upholds the minimalist ethos.
Furniture and Layout: Choose sleek, low-profile sofas (e.g., IKEA’s iconic designs) and compact coffee tables. In Hong Kong, mirrored walls can amplify natural light, addressing dim interiors.
Practical Tips: To counter winter chill, incorporate heated cushions or plush throws. Budget: approximately HKD 80,000–150,000, ideal for middle-class households.

blocks.heading: Minimalist Living Room Design: The Art of Less

blocks.alt: 2025 Living Room Design Guide — image 4

paragraphs: The Minimalist Living Room Design embodies the philosophy of “less is more,” eliminating superfluous elements to foster an open, uncluttered space. For Hong Kong’s small apartments, this approach can visually double the room’s size. Minimalism’s enduring elegance also ensures it remains a timeless choice for urban dwellers seeking simplicity.
Core Elements: Emphasize clean lines and concealed storage with seamless handles. Use a monochromatic palette of black, white, or gray, enhanced by glass or metal for a contemporary edge.
Furniture and Layout: Opt for wall-mounted TVs and foldable coffee tables to preserve floor space. Limit decor to a single focal point, such as an abstract painting.
Hong Kong-Specific Tips: Transform a living room into a multifunctional space with a work nook, using magnetic wall shelves—a 2025 trend.

blocks.heading: Modern Living Room Design: Innovation Meets Functionality

blocks.alt: 2025 Living Room Design Guide — image 5

paragraphs: The Modern Living Room Design merges cutting-edge technology with sleek aesthetics, appealing to Hong Kong’s trend-conscious residents. In 2025, this style incorporates AI-driven features, positioning the living room as a smart home hub. This style enhances property value, making it ideal for tech-savvy homeowners.
Embrace open layouts with metallic accents and bold colors like charcoal or navy. Concrete walls or modular panels add an industrial flair.
Install voice-activated lighting, automated blinds, or built-in audio systems. 3D-printed decor is a rising trend.

blocks.heading: Small-Space Living Room Design: Maximizing Compact Hong Kong Homes

blocks.alt: 2025 Living Room Design Guide — image 6

paragraphs: The small-space living room design is critical for Hong Kong’s typical 200-400 square foot residences. The goal is to blend multifunctionality with visual expansion. Small spaces can be transformed into versatile, stylish havens with thoughtful design.
Use mirrored walls or transparent furniture to create depth. Light-colored flooring reflects light, amplifying openness.
Invest in sofa beds or wall-mounted desks for dual-purpose functionality.
Solutions to Common Challenges: Limited storage? Install ceiling-height cabinets.

blocks.heading: Public Housing Living Room Design: Budget-Friendly Transformations
paragraphs: The Public Housing Living Room Design caters to Hong Kong’s standardized public housing units, where creative renovations can yield remarkable results on a budget.
Leverage existing structures with additions like screens or shelving for zoning. Avoid major structural changes to control costs.
Minimalist or Nordic styles integrate seamlessly with standard layouts.
Opt for durable PVC flooring and multifunctional TV units.

blocks.heading: Living Room Storage Cabinet Design

blocks.alt: 2025 Living Room Design Guide — image 7

paragraphs: The storage cabinet design in the living room is a cornerstone of Hong Kong homes, combining storage, display, and entertainment functionalities. A well-designed cabinet serves as both a practical solution and a striking focal point.
Cabinet Types: Modular units offer flexibility, while bespoke designs maximize wall space.

blocks.heading: What Defines Affordable Luxury?

blocks.alt: Affordable Luxury Home Design Trends 2025 — image 2

paragraphs: Affordable luxury, as its name suggests, represents a thoughtful approach to opulence. Unlike traditional luxury's bold statements, it embraces subtle sophistication, harmoniously blending elegance with functionality. At its core lies an appreciation for quality – expressed through premium materials, clean lines, and sophisticated color palettes. This style resonates particularly well with modern urbanites who seek to experience luxury in their daily lives without excessive ornamentation.

The design inspiration draws from various sources, from French classical elegance to modern minimalism, and the warm naturalism of Nordic design. paragraphs: The style frequently incorporates marble, metal, velvet, leather, and glass. For instance, a marble coffee table paired with a metal frame, or a velvet sofa adorned with leather cushions, exemplifies classic affordable luxury combinations. These materials not only elevate the visual appeal but also create a tangible sense of quality.

blocks.heading: 3. Refined Furniture: Clean Lines and Elegance

blocks.alt: Affordable Luxury Home Design Trends 2025 — image 4
Affordable Luxury Home Design Trends 2025 — image 5

paragraphs: Furniture selections favor clean, flowing lines over complex designs. Sofas, dining tables, and bed frames should exhibit smooth contours paired with high-quality materials. The incorporation of simple geometric patterns or lines can add a modern order to spaces, expressing pure design aesthetics without excess.

blocks.heading: 4. Sophisticated Detailing: The Art of Refinement
paragraphs: Artworks, sculptures, and designer pieces with strong aesthetic appeal are common in affordable luxury spaces. Crystal chandeliers and carved mirror frames can add unique character and sophistication to rooms.

blocks.heading: 5. Color Harmony: The Palette of Luxury

blocks.alt: Affordable Luxury Home Design Trends 2025 — image 6

paragraphs: The color scheme focuses on understated, neutral tones accented with occasional bright touches:

Base colors embrace ivory, light gray, and warm beige, creating open, comfortable spaces perfect for walls, floors, and large furniture pieces. Accent colors include deep blue, forest green, and burgundy, adding depth through sofas, carpets, or curtains. Metallic highlights in gold, silver, or champagne serve as finishing touches on lighting fixtures and accessories.

For example, ivory walls paired with a forest green velvet sofa and gold-framed mirrors create a sophisticated yet welcoming atmosphere. Adding light wood flooring or furniture can introduce natural warmth to soften the overall ambiance.

blocks.heading: 6. Functional Sophistication: The Marriage of Beauty and Utility

paragraphs: Affordable luxury emphasizes the union of practicality and aesthetics, enhancing both visual appeal and daily comfort.

blocks.alt: Affordable Luxury Home Design Trends 2025 — image 9

paragraphs: Nordic Affordable luxury represents a distinctive branch of affordable luxury, combining Scandinavian simplicity with refined opulence. This style has captured the hearts of younger generations through its unique characteristics:

Natural elements dominate through light oak or walnut wood, preserving natural grain patterns and warmth. Clean lines express design beauty through simple geometric shapes, enhanced by metallic or marble elements for contemporary sophistication. The color palette centers on whites and grays, accented with light wood tones and metallic highlights. Living plants or dried flowers add natural vitality to spaces.

For instance, a living room might feature a Nordic-style wooden sofa frame with velvet cushions and gold side tables, complemented by strategically placed greenery. This approach maintains Nordic simplicity while introducing elements of refined affordable luxury.

description: Hong Kong Home Decoration Style | Wabi-Sabi: 6 Keys in Interior Design and Decoration

paragraphs: Wabi-Sabi Aesthetics: Seeking the Path of Inner Serenity and Pristine Beauty

blocks.alt: Hong Kong Home Decoration Style | Wabi-Sabi — image 1

paragraphs: Trendy Home Decoration Style for 2024 | In the realm of Hong Kong's design industry, the Wabi-Sabi design style has emerged as a fresh trend. This style emphasizes simplicity, authenticity, and naturalness by stripping away elaborate decorations and pursuing the intrinsic texture and beauty of materials. How should one choose Wabi-Sabi furniture, flooring, and decorative paint? And how can plants and color schemes be used to create a minimalist and natural Japanese/Nordic Wabi-Sabi home? Below, we will introduce the Japanese Wabi-Sabi style, a home decoration style.

blocks.heading: What is Wabi-Sabi Style?

blocks.alt: Hong Kong Home Decoration Style | Wabi-Sabi — image 2

paragraphs: The term "Wabi-Sabi" originated from Taoism and Zen Buddhism in the Song Dynasty of China and later became an important philosophical concept in Japan. This design style not only pursues external simplicity but also emphasizes the tranquility felt from within. It carries a Zen spirit and blends warm and cozy elements of Nordic style, creating a unique and comfortable living atmosphere. Generally, Wabi-Sabi interior design revolves around earthy tones, emphasizing the flow of space, a sense of minimalism, and the use of graceful curves to create a distinctive and open ambiance.

blocks.heading: Wabi-Sabi Home Decoration: Imperfect Natural Elements

blocks.alt: Hong Kong Home Decoration Style | Wabi-Sabi — image 3
Hong Kong Home Decoration Style | Wabi-Sabi — image 4

paragraphs: In Wabi-Sabi home design, natural elements play a significant role. It does not seek perfection but rather appreciates the asymmetrical beauty found in nature. Unlike traditional Japanese or minimalistic styles, Wabi-Sabi retains the original appearance of the architecture or adds elements such as extended tree branches, flowing mud, etc., immersing individuals in the pure beauty of life.

blocks.heading: Wabi-Sabi Home Decoration: Ultimate Simplicity in Layout

blocks.alt: Hong Kong Home Decoration Style | Wabi-Sabi — image 5

paragraphs: Minimalism is one of the characteristics of Wabi-Sabi decoration. It pursues the utmost simplification of design elements and emphasizes the flow of space. By combining the curves and lines of objects, it creates a smooth and graceful composition, maximizing the sense of space while preserving the original qualities of the objects. Homeowners can not only appreciate the beauty of simplicity but also experience inner tranquility from the outside.

blocks.heading: Wabi-Sabi Home Decoration: Flooring and Furniture with Primal Texture

blocks.alt: Hong Kong Home Decoration Style | Wabi-Sabi — image 6

paragraphs: Texture is a crucial keyword in Wabi-Sabi style decoration. Regarding walls and floors, Wabi-Sabi designs often utilize textured materials such as artistic paints, diatomaceous earth, and concrete, incorporating natural, soft, and rough textures as design elements. In terms of furniture, materials like solid wood and ceramics are commonly used, and the subtle traces left by the passage of time interpret the profound realization of impermanence in Wabi-Sabi.

blocks.heading: Wabi-Sabi Home Decoration: Neutral and Warm Color Palette

blocks.alt: Hong Kong Home Decoration Style | Wabi-Sabi — image 7

paragraphs: In terms of overall color selection, Wabi-Sabi designs lean towards neutral and warm tones, primarily using shades of gray and white while incorporating some wooden and earthy hues to create a serene and warm spatial atmosphere.

blocks.heading: Wabi-Sabi Home Decoration: Handcrafted Art and Plant Decorations

blocks.alt: Hong Kong Home Decoration Style | Wabi-Sabi — image 8
Hong Kong Home Decoration Style | Wabi-Sabi — image 9

paragraphs: To enrich Wabi-Sabi home design, handcrafted art and plants have become indispensable elements. Handwoven textiles, pottery, and rattan chairs bring a sense of natural simplicity, while placing plants near windows allows them to complement the natural sunlight, adding vitality and dynamism to the space.

blocks.heading: Wabi-Sabi Home Decoration: Introduction of Natural Light

blocks.alt: Hong Kong Home Decoration Style | Wabi-Sabi — image 10

paragraphs: Light plays a crucial role in Wabi-Sabi design, creating a tranquil and pure ambiance. Designers focus on introducing natural light, utilizing sheer curtains or blinds, allowing light to flow softly like silk, freely weaving a poetic and dynamic atmosphere within the space.

Wabi-Sabi style is a Japanese aesthetic design style that seeks inner serenity. title: Commercial Interior Design and Branding: Interior Designer Eric Fung Shares Key Elements to Enhance the Value of Retail Spaces
author: ONCE DESIGN
description: Commercial Interior Design and Branding: Interior Designer Eric Fung Shares Key Elements to Enhance the Value of Retail Spaces

paragraphs: Eric Fung, our interior designer at Once Design Studio, recently shared his insights on the integration of commercial interior design with branding and its impact on the value of retail spaces in an interview with "Invest Smarter’’.

blocks.alt: Commercial Interior Design and Branding — image 1

paragraphs: In this article, we summarize the key points discussed, including the varying requirements of different industries in commercial interior design, considerations for renovating retail stores, and essential elements for successful integration of brand identity and design. If you're considering a commercial renovation project, store redesign, or shop refurbishment, read on for valuable insights.

blocks.heading: Commercial Interior Design: Emphasizing Brand Value and Customer Experience

blocks.alt: Commercial Interior Design and Branding — image 2

paragraphs: Commercial interior design differs from residential or other types of renovations. In a commercial environment, designers must consider how to effectively communicate the brand message to different customers, increase foot traffic and revenue, while creating a safe and functional space for operations and services. Eric emphasized that clients seeking commercial renovations place great importance on their brand value, aspiring to showcase a sophisticated and tasteful brand image within their premises.

To achieve a seamless blend of branding and interior design, contemporary commercial interior designers no longer focus solely on space beautification and eye-catching facades. Eric highlighted that Once Design Studio places a strong emphasis on incorporating brand stories and customer experiences into their interior designs. According to Eric, this is where interior designers excel, transforming brand concepts and narratives into tangible elements, effectively communicating messages to clients through the medium of interior design.

In commercial renovations, the customer experience is also a crucial consideration. Taking the retail industry as an example, designers need to carefully arrange product displays and establish effective spatial connections between different areas and services. Eric emphasized the significance of this step, as any errors or inflexibility in the flow can lead to a chaotic environment, negatively impacting the shopping experience for customers.

blocks.heading: Diverse Requirements Across Industries: Cosmetics Retail, Watch Brands, and Food & Beverage

blocks.alt: Commercial Interior Design and Branding — image 3

paragraphs: Different industries have unique requirements when it comes to commercial interior design. For instance, in the cosmetics retail industry, designers need to consider the daily skincare routines of customers, strategically arranging the display order of skincare and makeup products. In the case of watch or jewelry stores, iconic products or featured new items are usually placed in prominent positions. Essentially, interior designers must understand the characteristics and quantity of each product line in order to make appropriate arrangements within the spatial planning.

Many retail stores are located on bustling streets, presenting a challenge of standing out amidst the constant flow of people. Prior to commencing interior design planning, Eric explained that Once Design Studio conducts thorough research on the locality, assessing the presence of competitors in the same area and considering the color schemes of nearby stores or the surrounding environment. Subsequently, we incorporate the brand's core colors, concepts, and unique features into the store design to capture attention and distinguish ourselves in a highly competitive market.

Regarding the food and beverage industry, Eric pointed out, "Commercial renovation in the F&B industry is even more complex due to the involvement of food presentation. During the renovation process, coordination with different consultancy firms is required. If the restaurant is located within a shopping mall, compliance with mall regulations becomes crucial." Each mall has designated contractors for air conditioning and fire safety, making coordination with various partners necessary for retail renovation. Furthermore, since diners tend to spend more time in restaurants compared to regular retail stores, Once Design Studio approaches the project with a commercial perspective, ensuring that customers not only enjoy the food but also experience the restaurant's image and brand story.

blocks.heading: Once Design Ensures Efficient and Flawless Commercial Renovation

blocks.alt: Commercial Interior Design and Branding — image 4

paragraphs: With over 10 years of experience in interior design, Eric shared a memorable anecdote about commercial renovation during the interview: "In commercial renovation, there are instances where alterations or demolitions need to be carried out while the store will be opened for business as usual, and then the environment must be restored during operating hours. Typically, we only have one full night or a few hours in the midnight to complete the entire project, making thorough preparation work crucial. In such circumstances, any mistakes can impact store operations, posing a significant challenge in commercial renovation."

blocks.heading: Allocate Additional Budget for Compliance with Mall Renovation Regulations

blocks.alt: Commercial Interior Design and Branding — image 5

paragraphs: Eric also provided suggestions and considerations for clients interested in commercial renovation. He emphasized that different malls have their own renovation regulations and design requirements, necessitating careful adherence to these guidelines during the design and renovation process. "For example, Hong Kong's IFC requires the lighting design of shops to be connected to the mall's system so that the mall can control the brightness and lighting-off procedures. Additionally, some malls have regulations regarding shop signs, as they aim to create a consistent atmosphere throughout the mall without excessive individual characteristics in brand or shop sign design, ensuring a unified spatial environment." Moreover, tenants may need to allocate additional budget to meet regulatory requirements since each mall has designated contractors responsible for fire safety and air conditioning, which may entail higher costs than anticipated.

blocks.heading: Unique Brand Story Trumps Trendy Styles

blocks.alt: Commercial Interior Design and Branding — image 6

paragraphs: When discussing popular commercial renovation designs, Eric mentioned that the current trend leans towards minimalistic styles, but there is no specific prevailing trend. He stated that Once Design Studio focuses on translating the brand's underlying story and philosophy into design elements, making each brand's design style unique. As for future trends, with the continuous development of the retail industry, the integration of online and offline shopping elements will become increasingly important. Technological elements such as big data and artificial intelligence may also influence commercial renovation, aiding in enhancing and improving business models.

description: Hong Kong Corporate Office Design: Key Considerations for 3 Types of Companies

paragraphs: Modern offices are no longer just places for employees to work and receive clients. They have transformed into spaces that inspire creativity, foster learning, and ignite collaboration and interpersonal relationships.

blocks.alt: Hong Kong Corporate Office Design — image 1

paragraphs: Office interior design needs to provide different areas that encourage collaboration and communication, while also enhancing employee productivity and morale. It should consider style concepts, equipment, and overall space planning. In this article, we will discuss key considerations before planning office renovations and the interior design priorities for three types of Hong Kong companies: startup tech companies, space-efficient enterprises, and traditional companies. Which category does your company belong to?

blocks.heading: 【Key Considerations for Hong Kong Office Design Planning】

blocks.alt: Hong Kong Corporate Office Design — image 2

paragraphs: The primary task in office design is to determine the company's style and culture. What is your office's working model? When is the busiest time in the office? While considering renovation costs, it is also important to think about how the office design will impact employees and the company's working style. Additionally, you should consider the following points:
Company departments and staff count
Existing space configuration
Lease terms
Renovation budget
Office renovation regulations in Hong Kong

blocks.heading: 【Interior Design Considerations for 3 Types of Companies in Hong Kong】
Corporate Office Design | Tech Companies, Startups, or Emerging Enterprises

blocks.alt: Hong Kong Corporate Office Design — image 3

paragraphs: These companies typically adopt an open-plan office layout and provide various seating styles and arrangements. By reducing furniture purchases and renovations, costs can be saved.The office design for these companies differs significantly from traditional offices and should include areas for team collaboration and large conference spaces. Consider adopting the popular hot-desking model, which allows employees to choose their seats based on their tasks or communication needs, utilizing seating options such as lounges and benches that can accommodate multiple people.

blocks.heading: Corporate Office Design | Standard Offices, Space-Efficient Enterprises

blocks.alt: Hong Kong Corporate Office Design — image 4

paragraphs: This type of office design is similar to tech companies and startups, with a reduced number of individual offices to lower renovation and furniture costs. title: Hong Kong Commercial Interior Design: How to Boost Sales and Create Brand Value through Space Design?
author: ONCE DESIGN
description: Hong Kong Commercial Interior Design: How to Boost Sales and Create Brand Value through Space Design?

paragraphs: In the increasingly competitive Hong Kong retail industry, enhancing sales revenue and brand competitiveness, building brand identity, and attracting repeat customers are crucial, and interior design plays a pivotal role in achieving these objectives.

In today's Hong Kong retail landscape, the significance of interior design cannot be underestimated. The focus of commercial interior design has evolved beyond basic spatial layout, storefront design, and traffic flow organization. It now encompasses leveraging interior design to enhance brand recognition, convey brand stories (Storytelling), elevate customer experiences, and integrate with information technology to enhance spatial interactivity (Technology Interactive Design). Thoughtfully crafted interior designs and meticulously designed storefronts not only capture customers' attention and stimulate their purchasing desire but also strengthen brand value, leaving a lasting impression on consumers.

blocks.heading: Commercial Interior Design | Elevating the Customer experience

blocks.alt: Hong Kong Commercial Interior Design — image 2

paragraphs: Appropriate lighting, colors, and layout can create a pleasing shopping environment that offers customers a visually satisfying experience and an enjoyable shopping journey. The key distinction between online sales and physical retail lies in the customer experience, which online shopping fails to provide. Customer shopping experience encompasses the overall feelings and impressions that customers perceive during their shopping journey. It represents the interaction between customers and the brand, including the ambiance, product displays, service quality, and the shopping process itself. For instance, retail stores can utilize vibrant colors and music to create a lively atmosphere, as well as employ soft lighting to establish a comfortable ambiance. A delightful shopping experience not only enhances customer satisfaction but also increases the likelihood of repeat purchases.

Once Design Studio and designer Eric Fung reevaluate the characteristics and sales performance of each brand's products. Simultaneously, we consider customer behavior when trying out products and the overall customer experience, capturing customers' shopping psychology. By strategically arranging product displays, optimizing interior space layout and traffic flow, the entire shopping and sales process becomes more efficient and seamless.

blocks.heading: Commercial Interior Design | Amplifying Brand Value Through Storytelling

blocks.alt: Hong Kong Commercial Interior Design — image 3

paragraphs: Interior design plays a critical role in enhancing brand value and serves as an artistic expression of its essence.  A distinctive and recognizable storefront design heightens brand awareness while conveying brand values and principles.Through meticulous spatial planning, material selection, and curated art displays, interior designers have the power to showcase brand characteristics using specific patterns, logos, or slogans. By translating the core values of a brand into visual and sensory experiences, they evoke emotional resonance among individuals. Well-executed interior design also sets the brand apart from competitors, enhancing its uniqueness and competitiveness.

Once Design Studio is dedicated to using interior design as a medium to communicate brand concepts and image. Our team delves deep into the story and core values behind each brand, extracting unique and essential elements and ingeniously incorporating them into design details to leave a profound impression on customers' shopping experiences. Our goal is to gradually establish distinctive brand memories in customers' minds during their in-store visits, creating a positive impression through visual and sensory elements.

blocks.heading: Commercial Interior Design | Integrating Interactive Technology, Unlocking Business Opportunities

blocks.alt: Hong Kong Commercial Interior Design — image 4

paragraphs: Interior design plays a significant role in boosting retail revenue and establishing brand value. A creative and strategic store design can unlock immense business opportunities for retailers. By incorporating information technology to enhance spatial interactivity, retailers can attract more customers, increase sales volume, and improve profitability. For instance, integrating AR and VR technologies into digital signage can emphasize the physicality of products, providing customers with a more immersive shopping experience. It also allows seamless integration with the brand's online shopping platform, enabling customers to easily place orders.

Whether you are running a large chain store or a small boutique, interior design is a key factor in achieving success. Investing in interior design, carefully planned and executed by Once Design Studio, will yield sustained competitive advantages and elevate the brand value for retail businesses.

Hong Kong's retail landscape is set to expand with the addition of six new shopping malls in 2024, including The Southside, 11 Skies, Yoho Mix, Airside in Kai Tak, The Millennity, and SOGO Kai Tak.
